title: Deadline for Submission of Essays under Viksit Bharat Essay Challenge extended to 22 October 2026
body_text:
The Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue (VBYLD) 2027, a flagship youth engagement initiative of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, has received an overwhelming response from across the country, with 1,45,26,013 attempts recorded in the Viksit Bharat Quiz as part of the selection process. About 5.7 lakh youth who qualified in the Quiz round have moved to the next stage, the Viksit Bharat Essay Challenge, where they must submit a 500-word essay on the MY Bharat portal on the theme designated for their region.
The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports has extended the submission deadline for Stage II of the Viksit Bharat Essay Challenge to 22 October 2026, giving eligible youth more time to submit their essays for participation in VBYLD 2027.
Youth who have not yet submitted their essays are encouraged to do so by 22 October 2026 . The extension gives eligible participants more time to submit their essays and encourages wider participation in this national initiative.
The Ministry has also requested State Governments and Union Territory administrations to widely share the revised deadline with eligible youth and to ensure timely communication with district authorities and other stakeholders.
Through VBYLD 2027, the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports aims to foster youth participation, leadership, and innovation, providing young people with a platform to contribute meaningfully to the vision of Viksit Bharat @2047.
****
Pawan Singh Faujdar
